wiki.title: Patrick Sheehan (Illinois politician)
wiki.extract: Patrick Sheehan is an American politician who has served as a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives since April 12, 2024. Sheehan represents the 37th district which includes all or portions of Frankfort, Homer Glen, Joliet, Lockport, Mokena, New Lenox, Orland Park, and Tinley Park.
